duration_note: Estimation au débit réel de la première génération, puis fourchette 106–123 mots/minute. Le MP3 régénéré devra être mesuré pour confirmer 2h minimum et 2h30 maximum.
editorial_notes: Préserver la distinction centrale entre image trompeuse, atmosphère dangereuse et violence organisée. L’airlock est condensé autour de l’approche, de l’entrée et de la respiration ; aucun segment ne promet ensuite une description retirée. La théorie de la zone interdite conserve ses limites et ne transforme pas une hypothèse en certitude. Aucun mot nouveau.

before_last_two_sentences: His last moments carry him out of that view and back to her.
He dies on the exposed ground beside his wife, after removing the helmet that had kept her from his sight.
after_first_two_sentences: The birds give Juliette something she can recognize.
In the green view inside her helmet, their movement matches the recording she's already seen.
join_reviews.judgment: Raccord comparatif cohérent : la fin de Holston est suivie de l’indice permettant à Juliette de comprendre le même décor apparent. Le nom de Juliette réancre la scène.

before_last_two_sentences: Juliette continues across that area with an expanded map and very little shelter of her own.
Behind her, the camera still faces the hollow she has left.
after_first_two_sentences: The bodies around the entrance to Silo 17 leave Juliette with very little room to approach it without passing the people who came out.
They lie along the route between the underground structure and the open ground.
join_reviews.judgment: Raccord géographique direct : la sortie du cadre et les autres sites mènent à la porte de Silo 17, nommée dès la première phrase.

before_last_two_sentences: Whatever happened here, the entrance is still a possible shelter, and she needs to get inside while her suit can still protect her.
A structure that resembles her own silo offers the most practical destination she's found.
after_first_two_sentences: She gains entry, and the journey outside becomes an arrival inside another human structure.
There's no welcoming group waiting to explain the place.
join_reviews.judgment: Raccord interne direct : l’approche urgente mène à « She gains entry ». Le détail de manipulation des portes a été supprimé, pas l’entrée ni son résultat.

before_last_two_sentences: For Juliette, that's a direct answer to the most immediate question the entrance presents.
Reaching the building has brought her to an environment in which she can breathe without keeping her head enclosed.
after_first_two_sentences: Juliette has crossed between two separate openings and reached the interior of Silo 17 alive.
The journey has required a functioning suit, movement over exposed ground, and passage through an entrance bordered by bodies.
join_reviews.judgment: Bilan cohérent de la même action : Juliette respire à l’intérieur, puis le dernier paragraphe résume sa traversée et situe son nouveau refuge. Répétition courte acceptable pour clore la scène.

before_last_two_sentences: That leaves her in a new and very concrete situation: she's sheltered beneath the surface, in another silo, without the people or routines that made her own home familiar.
For now, she can breathe there, and she has enough shelter to begin finding her way farther in.
after_first_two_sentences: The warning Lukas encounters below the silo concerns a pipe that could kill the people living above him.
Down near the water, far from Bernard's archive and the ordinary work of IT, his search reaches something that can answer him.
join_reviews.judgment: Changement d’enquête compréhensible : après l’arrivée de Juliette, Lukas est nommé et sa recherche inférieure est resituée. Son rôle de shadow et la lettre de Quinn sont expliqués dans le passage gardé.

before_last_two_sentences: The internal safeguard could fail, and the residents could still be attacked through a separate external mechanism.
There's no need to assign every danger on the surface to that single installation beneath the silo.
after_first_two_sentences: In Silo 1's control room, the residents leaving Silo 17 are visible to people who aren't standing at its doorway.
Their departure becomes an event that can be followed elsewhere, inside another inhabited part of the underground system.
join_reviews.judgment: Raccord causal conservé : l’attaque externe est distinguée du Safeguard ; le contrôle de Silo 1 montre ensuite qui peut observer et commander cette attaque.

before_last_two_sentences: The wasteland contains exposed routes between underground shelters, and Silo 1 can send machines into those routes.
For the crowd outside Silo 17, the drones turn that capability into an attack before departure can become escape.
after_first_two_sentences: Stenson describes a nanoweapon danger when the underground project is explained in the Before Times.
That gives the proposed refuge a particular purpose.
join_reviews.judgment: Retour temporel explicite : après les moyens opérationnels actuels, « Before Times » situe la proposition de refuge et sa menace initiale.

before_last_two_sentences: What physically sustains Juliette's earlier journey is absent from his: protection that holds long enough for her to keep moving.
Bernard's walk ends on the exposed ground outside the refuge.
after_first_two_sentences: The radio connection across the silos becomes useful through Lukas and Kennedy's journey.
After surviving the attack outside, they reach Silo 17 with Lukas wounded.
join_reviews.judgment: Raccord cohérent : après le contraste entre protection et exposition de Bernard, la radio ouvre une possibilité de communication. Lukas et Kennedy sont nommés, leur état et leur destination immédiatement précisés.

before_last_two_sentences: The next practical question concerns the place a traveler hopes to reach: who maintains it, what it can provide, and whether the people inside will help.
A surface made passable for a journey can still lead to a refuge whose own survival is unfinished.
after_first_two_sentences: Victor watches the operation against the people leaving Silo 17.
That detail gives the ground around the entrances a different character from the one available through a cafeteria screen.
join_reviews.judgment: Passage de faits à théorie cohérent : la distinction traversée/habitat se conclut ; l’observation de Victor fournit la preuve de départ pour la zone interdite administrée.

before_last_two_sentences: The residents leaving Silo 17 face an additional intervention.
Both experiences can belong to the same damaged world, with people below ground still deciding what happens to those who come out.
after_first_two_sentences: The cafeteria camera still faces the ground outside Silo 18.
It gives residents a shared view, with the ridge marking the edge of what they can watch.
join_reviews.judgment: Conclusion naturelle : les deux hypothèses peuvent coexister ; le cadre de la caméra revient comme mesure de ce que les habitants savent et ignorent.
